2024
The revenue brought in by consulting firms in 2024 totaled 21,982 million euros, which accounts for 8.8% 
growth in comparison to the year before. This upward trend observed held steady another yet another 
year again, reaffirming the relevant contribution of consulting firms to the digital transformation within 
companies and government agencies, and the industry’s leading role in adapting business models to a 
continuously evolving environment.
